name: Jcode: Coding Agent
subtitle: The official Jcode mobile app
promotionalText: Chat with your Jcode coding agent running on your own cloud machine. Start tasks, follow tool calls live and review answers from anywhere.
description:
Jcode is an open-source AI coding agent. Jcode for iPhone connects to your Jcode Cloud machine so you can keep working with your agent away from your desk.

- Sign in with Apple, Google or a one-time email code.
- Chat with your agent in multiple session tabs.
- Follow running sessions and reopen recent repositories.
- Watch tool calls, file edits and command output stream in as the agent works.
- Read rich Markdown answers with code blocks and track task progress.
- Your cloud machine wakes on demand and sleeps when idle.

Cloud features require a configured Jcode account with cloud access. You can permanently delete your account from Settings inside the app.

review.notes: Sign in: on the sign-in screen, under 'or use email', type the demo email into the email field and tap 'Send code'. Then type the six-digit code given in the password field of this review information into the '6-digit code' field and tap 'Verify code'. No inbox access is needed for this account. After sign-in the app wakes the account's cloud machine (up to about a minute) and opens a chat. Send any message, for example 'Write a hello world in Rust', to see the coding agent respond. Account deletion: tap the menu button (top left) to open the sessions drawer, tap the account row with the gear icon to open Settings, then tap 'Delete account' and tap it again to confirm. The app has no in-app purchases and no purchase links. Voice availability depends on the account's entitlements. The supplied demo account supports cloud chat but does not currently have voice access, so it shows an unavailable message if the microphone is used. Sign in with Apple is also offered on the sign-in screen and creates a new, empty account. Optional extras: a Share extension (share text into Jcode), a Live Activity showing agent progress, and push notifications when an agent finishes. All require only the signed-in account.
